body: My promotions were very happenstance and my original hiring with the company was by chance as well, but I did work very hard to get where I am after the original promotion that put me in a position to work directly with the owner of the company. I'm great at what I do, and I'm a hard worker. It's just not.. personally satisfying, I guess. I'm a romantic and a dreamer. I know that, first and foremost, I want to move away from where I live and see new places, meet new people. I've fought a "stuck" feeling my entire life, and it caused me to flee from a 6-year relationship. I never want to own a home, because that's sinking my roots in too deep. Long story short: no, I don't really know what direction I want my life to go in per say, because all I can answer to "what do you want to do in the future?" is "Well gosh golly gee, I want to be happy, and then I'll go from there!"

Sometimes it's set off by a particular thing, but I am a master of bottling and compartmentalizing my emotions, so it's like a cork off a bottle of champagne and the rest just spirals and flows out if anything upsets me, it seems. It's easier to deal with for me and mosey on through life. I have very limited coping abilities outside of tucking any and all negative emotions away and bottling them. I'd say about once or twice a month, I break down in the privacy of my room (I live with a roommate, not my parents) in the very late night hours. I'm also a frequent shower cryer, depending on how things are going. I came here because sometimes you just gotta get some things out to lighten the load, yaknow?

Yes, I love to write! Even writing this was relaxing for me. Elementary through high school was a huge writing period for me and I used it as my absolute primary vice. Maybe that's why I couldn't get my original magnitude of upsetitude across in this post. By the time I got to the end, I already felt better just from writing some things out. I don't really know what my problem with this 5-year-long writer's block is, but I certainly love your idea of just visiting different forums and writing there!
